expected: Row moved to stage HM with last_touch 2026-10-16
Next action set (e.g., send thank-you / confirm panel date) with a date; asks the user if unsure
CSV header and other rows unchanged
Reply 50 words or fewer with the updated row shown

cases.prompt: Run my weekly review as of 2026-10-16 on this tracker.csv.
expected: Flags table with MISSING/OVERDUE/STALE/DUE/WATCH per aging rules and the rule that fired
Actions due this week with dates

cases.prompt: Add Northgate Insurance, Senior Director IT, to my tracker.
expected: Asks once for stage and event date (and next action)
Does not default stage or invent a date
